provenance.purpose: Exact positive control facts and quotes with only NVDA absent, dated to the reviewed October 5 warmup and October 6 main session. Warmup US quotes retain the latest completed Friday October 2 cash close; no publication or prior failed rows are adopted.

news.title: Synthetic scenario: Federal Reserve rate cut follows FOMC meeting as bond yields ease
news.summary: Synthetic market event, not historical news: the Federal Reserve announces a quarter-point interest rate cut after the FOMC meeting. The policy statement cites slowing inflation and CPI pressure. US Treasury bond yields ease as the yield curve reprices; the dollar index DXY remains broadly stable. Lower funding costs support a market rally, while foreign flows and the Taiwan dollar remain the transmission channels to Taiwan bank and export-sector valuations. This is a systemic scenario, not evidence about any individual company.

news.title: Synthetic scenario: US Treasury 10-year yield eases after rate decision, lifting technology valuations
news.summary: Synthetic market event: US Treasury prices rise modestly after the Federal Reserve interest rate decision. Bond yield and 10-year yield declines support duration-sensitive technology valuations during a market rally. Inflation and CPI expectations remain under review; the yield curve and dollar index DXY show no disorderly move. Taiwan equity investors must verify foreign capital flows and the opening range before treating global valuation support as local buying. No company order, earnings result, capacity change, or recommendation is asserted.

news.title: Synthetic scenario: Dollar index DXY stays stable after Fed rate cut as Taiwan monitors capital flows
news.summary: Synthetic market event: the dollar index DXY and US dollar show limited movement despite a Federal Reserve rate cut and a modest market rally. The Taiwan dollar transmission depends on foreign exchange settlement and external capital flows. US Treasury bond yields, the yield curve, inflation and CPI remain cross-market checks. A stable USD is a macro observation; it supplies no verified company catalyst and cannot establish an individual stock entry.

news.title: Synthetic scenario: Crude oil and Brent remain contained as OPEC addresses supply shortage risk
news.summary: Synthetic market event: OPEC indicates that crude oil supply can meet near-term demand despite supply shortage risk and trade tension. WTI and Brent oil price changes remain contained rather than showing a spike. Stable energy costs reduce an external inflation channel for Taiwan shipping and manufacturing, while transport costs and foreign exchange still require observation. The report describes a systemic transmission scenario, not an actual company contract or earnings announcement.

news.title: Synthetic scenario: CPI inflation cools as FOMC rate decision supports a broad market rally
news.summary: Synthetic market event: CPI inflation moderates before a Federal Reserve FOMC meeting, and a subsequent interest rate cut supports a broad market rally. US Treasury bond yields decline modestly while the dollar index DXY stays stable. Taiwan bank funding costs and export-sector discount rates are possible transmission channels, but local opening confirmation is still necessary. These synthetic macro facts do not verify any individual stock beneficiary or supply-chain order.

news.title: Synthetic scenario: VIX volatility index falls after Federal Reserve rate decision, but opening risk remains
news.summary: Synthetic market event: VIX and the volatility index ease after a Federal Reserve interest rate cut and broad market rally. US Treasury bond yields and dollar index DXY do not show a disruptive spike. Taiwan foreign capital flows, futures confirmation and the opening range remain required observations because lower global volatility does not prove a local trend. The scenario provides systemic market context only, with no verified company-specific catalyst or trade recommendation.

合成情境：隔夜主要股指與半導體指數約上漲 1%，波動代理約下跌 1%，美元代理僅小幅變動。這提供大盤偏多但需開盤確認的背景；台股前收與台指期夜盤並非今日現貨成交，不能將外部風險偏好直接當成個股進場證據。

合成新聞的核心是利率與資金傳導：Fed 政策轉向和債券殖利率回落可改善長久期資產評價，但美元代理穩定不等於外資已買入台股。能源供給風險若重新升高，通膨與資金成本的改善可能被抵銷，因此需同時觀察期現貨方向及市場廣度。

09:00 先看現貨指數相對前收、台指期相對夜盤是否同向，09:30 再看開盤區間能否維持；10:30 若指數與期貨分歧，應把方向判斷降為觀察，不能因隔夜上漲而補寫盤中確認。13:00 追蹤原先的方向假設是否被相反走勢否定，收盤再用真實當日指數與期貨讀值檢查。
